correctness.rationale: At the unique maximum index k, all reverse and forward partial-sum barriers must exceed gap w; by independence sum over k of q_k+(w)q_{n−k}−(w). Memorylessness gives q_j+(w)=exp(−aw)q_j+ for j≥1 and negative analog exp(−bw), so survival has three rates and positive weights summing to one. Two-sided exponential Wiener–Hopf/ladder root factorization of 1−z ab/[(a−t)(b+t)] yields the two square-root persistence GFs. Exact binomial coefficient tail controls asymptotic for fixed a≠b. Survival-density difference crosses once, so its maximum is exactly total variation; for equal rates it reduces to 1/2 binom(2n,n)/4^n. Independently computed persistence coefficients by separate square-root series and Sparre–Andersen binomial-tail recurrence for four rational rate pairs through n=12, all match; finite tests not source of unrestricted formula.
